integrity: Stationary marginal is covered by classical random-position renewal resetting and is not asserted as an original contribution. Exact autocovariance and sharp late-negative-lag phase diagram are the substantive claim. Historical priority is not independently certified; specialist switching-diffusion comparison has a remaining full-text access limitation.
limitations: Three equilateral reset sites with a directed cyclic Markov environment, independent Poisson resetting of the position only, isotropic planar Brownian diffusion, positive rates. Broad switching models and other target geometries not treated.
title: Oscillatory memory hidden by the stationary law of a cyclically reset Brownian particle
